scripts.build:examples: npm run build --workspace examples/vite-react && npm run build --workspace examples/vite-vue && npm run build --workspace examples/vite-svelte
scripts.lint: eslint packages/visdiff/src packages/visdiff/test packages/visdiff/tsup.config.ts examples/vite-react/src examples/vite-react/vite.config.ts examples/vite-vue/src examples/vite-vue/vite.config.ts examples/vite-svelte/src examples/vite-svelte/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/visdiff && tsc --noEmit -p examples/vite-react/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/vite-vue/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/vite-svelte/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test --workspace packages/visdiff
